messages:
maria (AE): Heads-up — Borealis wants to kick off a short POC this week. They plan to eval a custom 14B variant (borealis-14b-v2) with 4-bit quant and heavy KV-cache reuse. Major asks: latency target ~120ms p95, throughput ~40 rps, and an initial pricing estimate for hosted vs dedicated. Also they dropped a security questionnaire link: https://acme.example/qna — any blockers?
raj (ML Eng): Quick note — is the model using grouped-gemm or standard matmul? 4-bit strategy matters for kernel selection.
noah (Solutions Eng): @raj good call. Borealis-14b-v2 uses grouped quant + RMSNorm tweak. We saw ~20% perf delta vs baseline on our bench. For 120ms p95 at 512 tokens I'd expect dedicated or reserved with batching tuned.
simon (Runtime): We support grouped-quant but need to validate kernels for the RMSNorm variant. Can run a microbench — can you drop a small model tarball or HF repo link? Also KV-cache reuse pattern: is it prefix-heavy or sliding-window?
maria (AE): I'll ask them for the repo. Their initial traffic pattern is chatty but with long context reuse (prefix-heavy). They prefer cloud hosted first; dedicated if price is better.
raj (ML Eng): For prefix-heavy KV reuse, enable persistent KV shards and aggressive prefix caching. That reduces per-token compute. Example config we test with:
```
model: borealis-14b-v2
quant: 4-bit-grouped
kv_cache_policy: prefix_pinned
batch_strategy: latency_aware
max_seq: 2048
```
This usually drops cost ~30% vs naive.
noah (Solutions Eng): Good. For throughput 40 rps at 512 tokens, estimated GPU footprint is 1 x A100-80GB (dedicated) with continuous batching or 2 x for SLO headroom on hosted. Ballpark monthly reserved price ask? @elaine can you draft a list price vs reserved commit?
elaine (Sales Ops): I'll put together a pricing teardown. Early estimate: hosted e2e (per-token) ~ $0.0009/token for gen-heavy usage; dedicated reserved (monthly commit) would be lower by ~35% but needs 3mo term. I'll confirm exact numbers with finance.
security-bot: Borealis questionnaire flagged: "data residency" and "KMS integrations" sections incomplete. See ticket #SEC-842.
maria (AE): Thanks — Borealis requires EU residency for PHI-adjacent data. We should propose VPC Private deployment option if they're strict. @simon any constraints for Private?
simon (Runtime): Private control plane ok. On-prem requires packaging and handshake with their KMS/HSM. We have a documented runbook but lead time is ~3-4 weeks to validate HSM drivers. For initial POC recommending VPC with customer-managed KMS.
raj (ML Eng): One more perf note: quant-aware tokenization differences can alter perplexity. We should run a diff eval with their prompt set before rollout. Can we get 50 representative prompts?
maria (AE): I'll request prompts + HF link. Borealis also asked about function-calling and structured output stability. Are there known regressions with grouped quant?
noah (Solutions Eng): Function-calling should be fine; just validate JSON-schema enforcement in our evals. For grouped quant we sometimes see small arg-decoding flakiness on edge-cases — add those to the eval set.
elaine (Sales Ops): Action items: I'll draft price options and terms; maria will collect repo + prompts + questionnaire answers; simon + raj will run microbench and eval and report perf/lift by EOD Friday.
maria (AE): Perfect. If bench shows kernel gaps, do we have a migration path (fallback model variant) to keep POC timelines?
simon (Runtime): Yes — fallback path: switch to a compatible non-RMSNorm checkpoint (borealis-14b-v1-compat) or fall back to 8-bit quantized baseline. No infra change required, just model variant routing policy.
maria (AE): Great — I'll propose the two-track plan to the customer. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployed test harness for borealis-14b-v2 to staging cluster (staging-97) — job id: 87421. Logs: https://infra.example/logs/87421
raj (ML Eng): Saw initial perf logs — p95 at 512 tokens = 145ms on staging A100 with no prefix cache. With prefix_pinned config should drop to ~110-120ms. I'll push a tuned run.
noah (Solutions Eng): Nice. If tuned run hits SLO, we'll prepare an internal two-option quote (hosted vs 3mo reserved).
maria (AE): Cool. I'll sync with Borealis at 3pm PT today and update this thread after they send repo/prompts.
elaine (Sales Ops): I'll attach a draft quote once finance confirms numbers.
security-bot: Ticket #SEC-842 updated: awaiting customer KMS provider docs.
maria (AE): Closing loop for now. We may spin a follow-up thread for the legal/contract checklist. Thanks all.
